message.name: AgentCADeactivationStatusAdviceV01
message.definition: Scope|This message is sent by a CSD to an issuer (or its agent) to report the status, or a change in status, of a corporate action deactivation instruction or the status of a deactivation cancellation request.|Usage|This message is used to provide a status on the deactivation instruction, especially to confirm the deactivation of a Corporate Action event or option.

rules.name: DomesticOrProprietaryIdentificationSourceRule
rules.text: Either DomesticIdentificationSource or ProprietaryIdentificationSource must be present, but not both.

rules.name: DomesticOrProprietaryIdentificationSourceRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either DomesticIdentificationSource or ProprietaryIdentificationSource must be present, but not both.

rules.name: ISINOrOtherIdentificationRule
rules.text: Either ISIN or OtherIdentification must be present but not both.

rules.name: ISINOrOtherIdentificationRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either ISIN or OtherIdentification must be present but not both.

rules.name: CorporateActionIdentificationRule
rules.text: At least one element in the list (IssuerCorporateActionReference, OfficialCorporateActionReference, CorporateActionProcessingIdentifier) must be present. They may all be may be present.

rules.name: ProcessedStatusOrRejectedStatusRule
rules.text: Either ProcessedStatus or RejectedStatus must be present.

rules.name: ProcessedStatusOrRejectedStatusRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either ProcessedStatus or RejectedStatus must be present.

rules.name: DeactivationInstructionStatusOrDeactivationCancellationRequestStatusRule
rules.text: Either DeactivationInstructionStatus or DeactivationCancellationRequestStatus must be present.

rules.name: DeactivationInstructionStatusOrDeactivationCancellationRequestStatusRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either DeactivationInstructionStatus or DeactivationCancellationRequestStatus must be present.

rules.name: DeactivationInstructionStatusRule
rules.text: If AgentCADeactivationInstructionIdentification is present, then at least one occurrence of DeactivationInstructionStatus must be present.

rules.name: DeactivationCancellationRequestStatusRule
rules.text: If AgentCADeactivationCancellationRequestIdentification is present, then DeactivationCancellationRequestStatus must be present.
